text: {"assertions":["A broken email layout issue was fixed in notifications/email/render.py on 2026-03-29.","The problem manifested as a table overflowing in the plain text part of the email renderer.","The root cause was that the serializer was dropping fields it did not recognize.","The fix involved switching to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields in PR #1445 on branch fix/broken-layout-1.","The bug could be reproduced by rendering the digest template with a long subject.","The covering test is located in tests/notifications/test_render.py.","A flaky test was stabilized as a result, improving from 21 failures per 100 runs to zero failures."]}
